verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B300 is GPU and server hardware (the DGX B300 system), and setting up autonomous background automations is not a capability this kind of product ships, so the axis does not apply. BMC, Redfish and IPMI management, and the separate NIM or NeMo software docs are adjacent remote-management or developer tooling. They do not show that the product itself provides user-configurable autonomous automations, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
